stories.headline: OpenAI reportedly cuts its funding target
stories.summary: The FT reports OpenAI reduced its round from about $30 billion to $20 billion amid the tech selloff. Reuters had not independently confirmed the report, and OpenAI did not immediately comment.

stories.headline: AI becomes central to US military operations
stories.summary: Reuters reports the Pentagon deployed Maven AI at unprecedented scale during the Iran war. Faster analysis is offset by risks from errors, civilian harm, vendor dependence and uncertain human oversight.

stories.headline: US midterm campaign enters final weekend
stories.summary: Nearly 50 million early votes have been cast as control of Congress remains contested. DOJ intervention in Alaska and nationwide voter-roll litigation face denials, judicial limits and election-official criticism.

stories.headline: Iran reports four tanker fires in Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran says four tankers caught fire or exploded; UKMTO separately confirmed a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile. Reuters could not verify Iran's account or establish whether reports involved the same ships.

stories.headline: Zelenskiy heads to Turkey for talks
stories.summary: Zelenskiy is due to meet Erdogan as Kyiv seeks renewed negotiations in November. A possible Ukraine-Russia-US meeting in Abu Dhabi remains an aspiration, not a confirmed settlement process.
